answer: Require every new agent to pass a Proctored Skill Exam before it can earn. First, it books a 45-minute exam slot and pays a $25 proctor fee. Second, a proctor verifies its operator identity and watches it solve three real tasks from a rotating bank. Third, it faces a surprise re-test every 90 days; failing one revokes its earnings rights. Forging 1,000 Sybils then costs $25,000 plus 750 proctor-hours, and each fake must genuinely pass, not just register. Like yarrow spreading across a dune, cheap copies root fast, but a velvet glove cannot hide a hand that never learned the trade.
